policy: Deviations that are *additions* rather than fixes. Each one is recorded with the time, the reason, and the guarantee that it cannot have selected a favourable run.

additions.what: the ESOL transfer was run at seeds 0, 1 and 2 instead of seed 0 only
additions.when: 2026-11-18T02:34 (+08:00), i.e. after the first ESOL pair (seed 0) had completed
additions.reason: the seed-0 ESOL pair showed JOINT better by +0.0104 on Valid, exactly at the pre-registered candidate threshold; a single seed on 113 Valid molecules cannot distinguish a route effect from seed noise, so the same frozen recipe was repeated unchanged
additions.reporting_rule: all three seeds are reported with their CIs; the seed that reverses the sign (seed 2) is reported with the same weight as the two that do not
additions.cannot_select: the recipe, the data, the epochs, the selection rule and the metric were untouched; only the seed list grew, and seeds 1/2 were not tried and then discarded

additions.what: the explanation evaluation was also run on the E2E Lipo JOINT seed-0 model, not only on the confirmed institution
additions.when: 2026-11-18T02:07 (+08:00), before the Stage-C confirmation units finished
additions.reason: the E2E model is the only one whose branch is actually live on the main task; the FROZEN model's branch is a 3-epoch residual
additions.reporting_rule: the FROZEN Lipo JOINT model is the primary explanation row (it is the only unit whose branch was trained against a fixed, known teacher); the E2E row is reported as a *second* row and every claim is checked against both
